newsitem.title: USA: FDA allows C.R. Bard to market catheter.
newsitem.headline: FDA allows C.R. Bard to market catheter.

text.p: U.S. Food and Drug Administration has authorized C.R. Bard Inc to market its USCI ProCross over-the-wire balloon dilatation catheter with Rely balloon material and Hydro/Pel coating, the company said Thursday.
C.R. Bard, which manufacturers health care products, said it planned to release the catheter in the United States in October.
It said it sold the Rely balloon material on both an over-the-wire and rapid exchange platform elsewhere in the world.
C.R. Bard also said it had launched its X-Trode coronary stent in Australia and Europe.
